lines.text: Our wind turbine techs work in remote mountain areas without cellular reception.
Our platform architecture handles offline queuing seamlessly on all mobile apps.
We need our maintenance logs synced into Salesforce CRM.
We will have the standard CRM sync connector live within twenty-one days.
We also have turbine inspection spreadsheets that need importing.
We can handle the CSV migration within thirty days of contract signature.
Can we pull real-time turbine vibration alerts via SCADA integration?
Perhaps we can evaluate SCADA integration later, but it is not in current scope.
